### A

```{r tangency-portfolio}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
stocks <- setdiff(names(a), c("Date", "^GSPC"))
tickers <- c("^GSPC", stocks)
a1 <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2018-01-01") &
          a$Date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), ]
prices1 <- as.matrix(a1[, tickers])
r1 <- prices1[-1, ] / prices1[-nrow(prices1), ] - 1
market1 <- r1[, "^GSPC"]

alpha1 <- beta1 <- residual_var <- var_beta1 <- numeric(30)
for (i in seq_along(stocks)) {
  fit <- lm(r1[, stocks[i]] ~ market1)
  alpha1[i] <- coef(fit)[1]
  beta1[i] <- coef(fit)[2]
  residual_var[i] <- summary(fit)$sigma^2
  var_beta1[i] <- vcov(fit)[2, 2]
}

keep <- beta1 > 0
Sigma <- outer(beta1[keep], beta1[keep]) * var(market1) +
  diag(residual_var[keep])
mu <- alpha1[keep] + beta1[keep] * mean(market1)
Rf <- 0.001
R <- mu - Rf
Z <- solve(Sigma, R)
w_G <- Z / sum(Z)
mean_G <- sum(w_G * mu)
sd_G <- sqrt(drop(t(w_G) %*% Sigma %*% w_G))
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks[keep], Beta = beta1[keep],
                 Weight = w_G), digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Rf, Mean = mean_G, SD = sd_G), digits = 6)
```

### B

```{r beta-adjustments}
a2 <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2023-01-01") &
          a$Date <= as.Date("2026-09-30"), ]
prices2 <- as.matrix(a2[, tickers])
r2 <- prices2[-1, ] / prices2[-nrow(prices2), ] - 1
market2 <- r2[, "^GSPC"]
beta2 <- numeric(30)
for (i in seq_along(stocks)) {
  fit <- lm(r2[, stocks[i]] ~ market2)
  beta2[i] <- coef(fit)[2]
}

# Blume: forecast betas for the period after September 2026.
blume <- lm(beta2 ~ beta1)
beta_blume <- coef(blume)[1] + coef(blume)[2] * beta2
coef(blume)

# Vasicek: forecast betas for January 2023-September 2026.
beta_mean <- mean(beta1)
beta_var <- var(beta1)
beta_vasicek <- (var_beta1 * beta_mean + beta_var * beta1) /
  (beta_var + var_beta1)
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Beta1 = beta1, Beta2 = beta2,
                 Blume = beta_blume, Vasicek = beta_vasicek),
      digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

### C

```{r vasicek-press}
# Mean squared beta prediction error.
PRESS <- sum((beta_vasicek - beta2)^2) / length(stocks)
kable(data.frame(PRESS), digits = 6)
```
